fieldValues.title: Every request is placed in a domain first
fieldValues.decision_question: When is a request placed in a domain?
fieldValues.context: D4 of clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md, section 8), asked of the owner since 2026-10-12. Recorded as a proposed decision on 2026-10-16 so a session can take it: until now it existed only as PR text, which no session agenda reads.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Every request is placed in a domain before any group assesses it.
fieldValues.rationale: Without placing first, a request lands on the owner or is filed straight as work, with no assessment against a group's priorities (proposal section 1).
fieldValues.revisit_when: I5's returned share stays high for two cycles.
